_meta.purpose: Non-color design tokens (type / spacing / radius / elevation / motion) — the documentation layer engineers implement against. Colors live in palettes.json (the 17-role QdPalette schema). All px are in the 1920x1080 layout space; handheld 1280x720 is a downscale.
_meta.viewing: rendered at 1920x1080, read at 720p / TV distance — favour bold, legible, high-contrast

type._note: Plutonium renders at named buckets (Small/Medium/MediumLarge/Large) plus registered extras at 22/18/14 px. Map below. Min legible 14px @1080.
type.family_mono: IBM Plex Mono (OFL) — paths, hex, technical

space._note: 4/8/12/18/24/36/48 ramp — reflects live geometry (dock gap 18, grid gap 12, padding 12, window stagger 36, topbar 48).

radius._note: One corner-radius language. The big cohesion win: selection outline shares the radius of the element it rings.
radius._sm_use: selection outline, small tiles, badges, buttons
radius._md_use: window bodies (was 8 — propose 12), panels, folder tiles
radius._pill_use: window traffic-light + resize buttons (stay circular), toggle pills
radius._pixel_note: decision: Pixel keeps rounded corners too (full cohesion)

elevation._note: Cheap to approximate on SDL: hard offset rect + alpha (no blur). Shadows stay neutral black (never tinted). Focus uses a tinted glow, not an offset.

motion._note: Tiny budget — discrete state changes, not continuous tweens. Spec timings as guidance only; nothing the Switch can't ship.

theme_transition.note: DrawThemeTransitionFrame — destination-palette splash + Q emblem + ASCII loading dots

loading_spinner.note: frame = floor(clock_ms/90) % N — monotonic-clock driven, never frame-locked; see brand/loading spec
